name: Saltoluokta-Sitojaure

difficulty.label: Moderate mountain stage with steep initial climb, exposed plateau and remote roadless endpoint
difficulty.source: STF and Naturkartan describe an easy-going trail surface but a fairly steep climb from Saltoluokta, open mountain/heath terrain, Autsutjvagge shelter about halfway and descent toward STF Sitojaure.
caveats: No formal official difficulty grade was found.
Early route-finding from Saltoluokta has several branching/parallel paths; Naturkartan warns hikers to keep left on Kungsleden after side-trail junctions.
The stage is exposed after the first climb and can be affected by wind, snow, ice and low visibility outside settled summer conditions.
Elevation figures conflict across secondary sources; do not import ascent/descent until the final selected geometry is profiled.

notes: Official hiking stage order is Saltoluokta to Sitojaure.
This is STF stage 1 of the Saltoluokta-Kvikkjokk Kungsleden route, not an official STF 'section 9' number.
Vakkotavare-Kebnats-Saltoluokta is a prior road/bus plus passenger-boat transfer and should not be included in this section's hiking geometry.
The next southbound continuation from Sitojaure toward Aktse requires a separate Sitojaure-Svijnne/Svine boat connector; it is not part of section 9 hiking geometry.

protectedAreas.name: Ultevis fjallurskog
rulesSummary: Camping, hiking, berry/mushroom picking, making fires, snowmobile use on well-snow-covered ground, and fishing/hunting under applicable law are allowed.
Damaging plant or animal life is not allowed.
Older component reserves may retain local regulations, so signs and reserve decisions should be checked locally.

protectedAreas.name: Laponia / Stora Sjofallet / Sarek boundary context near Saltoluokta
rulesSummary: No direct evidence was found that the selected 19 km stage enters Stora Sjofallet/Stuor Muorkke National Park or the stricter Laponia national-park rule zone.
Saltoluokta is at or near the boundary; final selected-line GIS overlay is still needed before rules normalization.
If detouring into Laponia/Stora Sjofallet, stricter rules such as drone permission restrictions apply.

dogs.summary: Dogs should be leashed March 1-August 20 in nature and under strict control in reindeer-herding areas. Treat this section as leash-required in practice year-round because it is reindeer-herding country.

reindeer.summary: Active reindeer-herding area; avoid disturbing reindeer, keep dogs leashed and be especially cautious during April-June calving sensitivity.

huntingAndFishing.summary: Fishing/hunting are allowed only under applicable laws and permits. For Norrbotten mountain fishing, state waters above the cultivation limit require permits; 2026 Jokkmokk rules include no grayling fishing in Gallivare/Jokkmokk/Arjeplog May 10-June 10 and no fishing in flowing water September 1-December 31 because of trout spawning. 2026/2027 small-game hunting details must be rechecked before late-August/September hikes.

drones.summary: No explicit Ultevis drone ban was found on the Lansstyrelsen visitor page, but Transportstyrelsen rules and Dronechart still apply. If the route/detours enter Laponia/Stora Sjofallet, Laponia states drones are forbidden in the entire World Heritage Site without County Administrative Board permission.
